creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Five cards on `main` have `column = ""` and `position = ""`. They render in no column, so they're invisible in the board view and will be dropped silently by any column-based migration - including the merge of this sprint board back into `main`.

- `rad-explain-list` - `rad explain list` should show each error doc's `#` heading next to its code
- `add-llms-txt` - no description; likely obsolete, llms.txt generation already exists at `docs-web/hooks/generate_llms_txt.py`
- `escaping-interpolation` - no way to escape `{`; the regex constraint `"\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}"` silently became `\d-\d-\d`. Same root as the p1 parse-error card, and it proposes `{{` as the escape
- `date-parsing` - probably stale, `parse_date()` exists
- `function-for-sorting` - `sort(items, key=fn(x) x["points"])` or `sort_by`

Triage into columns or delete. Two look already-answered, which is why they need a decision rather than a move.

---

### Orientation

- This is executed with the `kan` CLI, not with code. Nothing in `core/`, `rts/`, or `radls/` changes.
- Board data is plain JSON on disk at `.kan/boards/main/cards/<id>.json`. The five orphans are the files where `"column": ""` and `"position": ""`.
- Verified `main` board columns and their WIP limits (`kan column list -b main`): `uncommitted` (20), `low` (146), `high` (9/10), `next` (1/10), `in-progress` (3/5), `done` (74). `high` and `next` are near their limits - check before moving anything there.

### Where to start

The five, with IDs verified from `.kan/boards/main/cards/`:

| id | alias | title |
|---|---|---|
| `a_dpgQ5KqD` | `rad-explain-list` | rad explain list should show summaries alongside codes |
| `a_lJarzcUb` | `add-llms-txt` | add llms.txt |
| `a_m0uQC1ua` | `escaping-interpolation` | escaping interpolation apparently unclear |
| `a_m0vosQ81` | `date-parsing` | date parsing functionality |
| `a_m0xSHTFY` | `function-for-sorting` | function for sorting by keys |

Commands:

```sh
# re-derive the list rather than trusting this table
kan list -b main --json | jq -r '.cards[] | select(.column == "") | "\(.id)  \(.alias)  \(.title)"'

kan show <id> -b main --json          # full description before deciding
kan edit <id> -b main -c <column>     # triage into a column
kan delete <id> -b main               # or drop it
kan doctor -b main                    # confirm no consistency issues remain
```

**Never pass `-f` / `--field` on `kan edit`** - it sets custom fields and will clobber labels.

Triage evidence, verified in-repo:

- **`rad-explain-list`** - the surface it targets is deprecated. `core/embedded/explain` opens with "Deprecated - use 'rad docs' instead" and prints a deprecation notice on every run, saying it will be removed. The backing function is `_rad_explain_list() -> str[]` (`rts/signatures.go:73`, implemented at `core/funcs_internal.go:158`), which returns bare codes. The feature the card asks for is real and cheap - error docs already carry the heading it wants, e.g. `core/error_docs/40008.md` line 1 is `# RAD40008: Deprecated Block Keyword` - but it should be re-pointed at `rad docs`, not built on a command that is on its way out. Decision, not a move.
- **`add-llms-txt`** - `docs-web/hooks/generate_llms_txt.py` exists. Confirm it is wired into `docs-web/mkdocs.yml` as a hook, then close as done.
- **`escaping-interpolation`** - still open. There is no `{{` escape today; the grammar's only escape is `esc_open_bracket: token.immediate("\\{")` (tree-sitter-rad v0.6.0 `grammar.js:1165`), i.e. `\{`. The card proposes `{{`. Same root cause as the p1 parse-error card - link them rather than duplicating the work.
- **`date-parsing`** - `docs/funcs/parse_date.md` exists, as do `parse_epoch`, `format_epoch`, and `now`. Read the card's description for anything those four do not cover; otherwise close as done.
- **`function-for-sorting`** - still open. Verified there is no `sort_by`, and `sort`'s signature has no `key` parameter: `sort(_primary: list|str, *_others: list|str, *, reverse: bool = false) -> list|str` (`docs/funcs/sort.md`). Overlaps the p2 stdlib-gaps card, which also lists `find(list, fn)` - consider folding it in there.

### How to verify

```sh
kan list -b main --json | jq -r '[.cards[] | select(.column == "")] | length'   # expect 0
kan doctor -b main
git status .kan/                       # the JSON files should show the changes
```

### Done when

- No card on `main` has an empty `column`. The jq check above returns 0.
- Every one of the five is either in a column or deleted, and the two already-answered ones (`add-llms-txt`, `date-parsing`) got an explicit decision rather than a default move to `low`.
- `kan doctor -b main` exits clean.
- Labels on the surviving cards are unchanged.

### Watch out for

The card is right that a column-based migration would drop these silently - so do this **before** merging the sprint board back into `main`, not after.
title: Rescue the five orphaned cards on the main board
